From: Marta Alvarez <marta@eudorahealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@eudorahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Retention carveout & CAIQ artifacts request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Eudora's security and procurement teams are reviewing Redwood for a pilot and we need a compact package that maps how you handle customer-specific retention carveouts for EU healthcare tenants. Specifically we need:

- A short mapping of log types (application logs, inference traces, debug traces, audit logs) to the default retention windows and where exceptions can be applied per-tenant.
- A one-page description of the proof-of-delete / proof-of-redaction flow you can provide for a customer-scoped erasure (what artifacts are produced, typical timelines, and any immutable identifiers).
- The CAIQ answers for the data lifecycle questions or a CAIQ export.
- Any SOC 2 attestation or auditor contact (redacted copies are fine).

We have an internal milestone on Oct 15 to sign pilots. Can you confirm what you can deliver and by when? Also attached a short scope doc (Eudora_SoW.pdf) that outlines the pilot tenant details.

Best,
Marta
Head of Security, Eudora Health

Attachments: Eudora_SoW.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

Team — forwarding Eudora ask. Summary of deliverables they want: retention mapping, a proof-of-delete description (artifact list + sample manifest), CAIQ export, and SOC 2 auditor note.

Proposed split of work:
- Priyom: assemble the evidence bundle (TOC, sample erase manifest, export of CAIQ answers). See example headers below I think will satisfy the procurement team. Target: draft bundle by Oct 5.
- Irene: confirm what we can commit for EU tenant log windows (default vs per-tenant exceptions) and the operational steps for manual erase. Also confirm whether we can provide tenant-scoped encrypted snapshot IDs as part of the manifest. Target: Oct 3 for retention mapping doc.
- Ben: legal / redlines — can you prepare a short assertion text we can include (1 paragraph) and whether we need to route to contracts for any addendum?

Key constraints / reminders:
- All internal replies must only reference internal artifact names until we scrub sensitive IDs for external delivery.
- If proof-of-delete requires a cross-team action (infra + SRE), loop them now.

I'll reply to Marta once we have internal commitments.

— Soojin

Soojin — putting a first-pass together. Draft contents I'm preparing:

1) evidence_toc.txt (plain text TOC) — will list CAIQ export (csv), SOC2 summary (redacted PDF), retention_mapping.csv, sample_erase_manifest.json (redacted), and a short operational runbook (pdf).
2) sample_erase_manifest.json — minimal fields: tenant_id (redacted), timestamp, list of deleted object keys, sha256 hashes, snapshot_id (where applicable), deletion-job-id. We'll provide an example manifest and a short explanation of how the manifest is generated.
3) retention_mapping.csv — rows for each log type + default ttl + allowed carveout min/max + required approvals.
4) CAIQ export — our completed CAIQ answers CSV filtered to lifecycle questions.

Notes / clarifications:
- Proof-of-delete: For EU tenants we can provide an S3 object manifest plus a deletion job record. For on-prem or private deployments we can provide the same manifest schema but the snapshot_id will map to the customer's archive location. We will not publish raw S3 paths; we will provide hashed object ids and timestamps.
- Timeline: I can assemble a draft bundle by Oct 5 and then we iterate. If Legal needs to sign off on the assertion paragraph, allow 2 business days after I submit.
- Attachments I will include in the draft: evidence_package_v1.zip (contains placeholder files).

If Irene can confirm the retention windows and any limitations for tenant carveouts (e.g., minimum retention for forensic trace retention for 30 days in EU), I'll merge that into the mapping.

Thanks — Priyom
Principal Compliance Engineer

Attachments: evidence_package_v1.zip (archive/placeholder)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Retention carveout & CAIQ artifacts request — delivery plan

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the SoW. Quick update and commitment from Redwood:

What we'll deliver by Oct 7 (compact evidence bundle):
- CAIQ lifecycle export (CSV) scoped to Eudora's questions.
- Retention mapping (CSV) that enumerates: log type, default retention, per-tenant carveout range, and procedural pre-reqs for carveout.
- Sample erase manifest (redacted) + short explanation of artifact fields (sha256 of object ids, snapshot_id, deletion_job_id, timestamps).
- A one-page proof-of-delete flow diagram and short runbook (PDF) describing timelines and handoffs for tenant-scoped erasure requests.
- A redacted SOC 2 summary + contact point (auditor email masked).

What we cannot include: raw S3 paths or unredacted customer object ids. Instead we will provide hashed identifiers and signed deletion-job ids as proof.

Next steps:
- Proposed call: Tue Oct 6 09:00 BST to walk the bundle and answer any follow-ups (15–20 min). I can make that meeting if it works for your team.
- Delivery: I'll attach the draft evidence bundle to an email to you on Oct 7 and share a link to the Drive folder (links will be scrubbed for public copies).

If Eudora needs an explicit contractual carveout (i.e., an addendum that changes retention terms in the master agreement), we'll flag that to Contracts after the bundle review. Ben, please advise on required language if any.

Appreciate the timeline — we're aligned on your Oct 15 milestone.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
